'''Noori sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Star system/Legends|Star systems]] in the sector included [[Celegia system/Legends|Celegia]] and [[Noori system/Legends|Noori]].
